### Redlining City Overlays

#### Project goal

Make interactive redlining maps available to City Health Dashboard users.

#### My role

* Literature review to assess relationship between redlining and health outcomes
* Explore geodata files and potential mapping options
* Proposal for integrating redlining into existing website
* R code to clean geodata files and intersect with city boundaries
* Collaboration with UX and communication teams to develop feature
* [Blog to announce and explain overlays](https://www.cityhealthdashboard.com/blog-media/new-map-feature-redlining)

#### Sample R code

* Select "Show" to view

```{r redlining, eval=FALSE}

#HOLC boundaries
holc <- read_sf("HOLC-Redlining\\Data\\mappinginequality.json") %>%
  #only keep boundaries from the original HOLC city survey, remove commercial and industrial areas
  filter(city_survey == T & commercial == F & industrial == F & grade != "E") %>%
  #re-project to NAD83 to match internal files
  st_transform(4269) %>%
  mutate(holc_area = units::drop_units(st_area(geometry)))

#city boundaries
city_file <- dashboard_city_list %>%
  mutate(city_area = units::drop_units(st_area(geometry)))

#identify cities with >5% of the city covered by a HOLC grade
  coverage_filter <- st_intersection(city_file,holc) %>%
    group_by(geo_fips,geo_name,state_abbr,city_area) %>%
    summarise() %>%
    mutate(intersect_holc_full = units::drop_units(st_area(geometry)),
           per_overlap_city = round(intersect_holc_full/city_area*100,1)) %>%
    filter(per_overlap_city >= 5)

#Intersect, apply filters
intersect <- st_intersection(city_file,holc) %>%
  #filter out "sliver" overlaps of graded areas that only barely overlap (<10%)
  mutate(intersect_area = units::drop_units(st_area(geometry)),
         per_overlap_area = round(intersect_area/holc_area*100,1)) %>%
  filter(per_overlap_area > 10) %>%
  #dissolve by city*grade for final maps
  group_by(census_parent_shape_year,geo_fips,geo_level,geo_name,state_fips,state_name,state_abbr,grade) %>%
  summarise() %>%
  #select only cities that have sufficient holc coverage
  filter(geo_fips %in% coverage_filter$geo_fips)

```

#### Final product

[Indianapolis Redlining Map](https://www.cityhealthdashboard.com/IN/Indianapolis/metric-detail?metricId=6&dataPeriod=2023&focus=grade&grade=A&grade=B&grade=C&grade=D)

```{r, out.width="400px", collapse=T}
knitr::include_graphics(path = "images\\redlining_indianapolis.png")
```
